title: Work out the rule
text: This equation cancels the common factor of $$x^2+1$$ in the numerator and denominator, which is the rule $$\frac{ab}{ac}=\frac{b}{c}.$$ \n Note that we can think of this rule as a clever multiplication by $$1$$ since $$\frac{ab}{ac}=\frac{a}{a}\frac{b}{c}=1\frac{b}{c}=\frac{b}{c}.$$
